2026_05_HOU_TEN.headline: Houston’s defensive reset faces Tennessee’s struggling offense
2026_05_HOU_TEN.paragraph1: Houston enters its divisional meeting with Tennessee searching for a first victory despite promising stretches from C.J. Stroud. The Texans have struggled to finish defensive possessions, prompting DeMeco Ryans to take over play-calling duties. Tennessee has not reached 300 offensive yards in a game, giving Houston an opening to attack early downs and force difficult third-down situations. The Titans must avoid negative plays and find a reliable way to sustain drives; otherwise, Houston’s defensive adjustment could give Stroud repeated short fields and a much more manageable game.
2026_05_HOU_TEN.model_rationale: Houston’s defensive play-calling change could help it close possessions against a Tennessee attack that has struggled to move the ball. The Titans must improve early-down execution to resist pressure.
